sn47.34:1.1: Sāvatthiyam || || Cattāro me bhikkhave satipaṭṭhānā bhāvitā bahulīkatā aparāparaṅgamanāya saṃvattanti ||
sn47.34:2.1: katame cattāro || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati || [pe] || Vedanāsu || Citte || Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvitā bahulīkatā aparāparaṅgamanāya saṃvattantī ti || || 1--2.
